metadata.question: In 2021, did the Antarctic ozone hole reach a size of 18 million square kilometers?

data.raw_code: The question is about the Antarctic ozone hole size in 2021. This requires: 1. Finding ozone hole data - likely from NASA OMI or similar ozone monitoring instruments 2. Looking for the maximum extent/size of the ozone hole in 2021 3. Comparing if it reached 18 million square kilometers For ozone data, I can use: - NASA OMI (Ozone Monitoring Instrument) data - Or TOMS (Total Ozone Mapping Spectrometer) data - Need to find the ozone hole area/extent The ozone hole is typically defined as areas with total ozone less than 220 Dobson Units. I'll need to: 1. Get ozone data for 2021 over Antarctica 2. Mask for ozone values < 220 DU (ozone hole definition) 3. Calculate the area of this region 4. Check if it reached 18 million km² Let me use OMI data which should be available in Earth Engine. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Antarctica region (approximate bounding box) const antarctica = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, -60]); // Define time period for 2021 ozone hole season (August-October) const startDate = '2021-08-01'; const endDate = '2021-10-31'; // Get OMI ozone data const ozoneCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OMI/DATA_MONTHLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(antarctica) .select('ColumnAmountO3'); // Check if collection has data const colSize = ozoneCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Ozone images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate monthly ozone hole areas and find maximum const monthlyAreas = []; const months = ['Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct']; for (let i = 0; i < colSize; i++) { const img = ee.Image(ozoneCol.toList(colSize).get(i)); const date = img.date().format('YYYY-MM').getInfo(); // Define ozone hole as areas with ozone < 220 Dobson Units const ozoneHole = img.lt(220); // Calculate area in square kilometers const areaStats = ozoneHole.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctica, scale: 25000, // 25km scale for ozone data maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelArea = areaStats.get('ColumnAmountO3').getInfo(); if (pixelArea === null) { console.log(`No valid pixels for ${date}`); monthlyAreas.push(0); continue; } // Convert pixel count to area (assuming 25km pixels) const areaKm2 = pixelArea * 625; // 25km × 25km = 625 km² per pixel const areaMillionKm2 = areaKm2 / 1e6; console.log(`${date}: ${areaMillionKm2.toFixed(2)} million km²`); monthlyAreas.push(areaMillionKm2); } if (monthlyAreas.length === 0) { console.log("No valid ozone hole calculations"); console.log("C2"); return; } // Find maximum ozone hole area in 2021 const maxArea = Math.max(...monthlyAreas); console.log(`Max ozone hole area 2021: ${maxArea.toFixed(2)} million km²`); console.log(`Target: 18.00 million km²`); // Validate result if (maxArea === null || maxArea === undefined || isNaN(maxArea) || maxArea < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (maxArea >= 18.0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
